/* PdaInspectPaisMapper.selectBmsInWithInspectResult : BL리스트와 검사결과,박스갯수 */ SELECT I.IN_PLAN_NO
, CASE WHEN I.IN_PLAN_NO = #{recentFinishedInPlanNo} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS LIST_ORDER
, I.IN_NO , I.MBL_NO , C.HSN , I.OD_JOB_NO , I.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , I.BL_NO , I.CT , I.WT , (SELECT MAX(PACKING_NO) FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = I.IN_PLAN_NO ) AS PACKING_NO , (SELECT COUNT(IN_CT) FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = I.IN_PLAN_NO ) AS PACKING_CNT , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'S' THEN '선별 ' + ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'X' THEN 'XR ' + ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y' AND UPPER(CODE) NOT IN ('C')), '') WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'P' THEN '통관 ' + ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'I' THEN '검역 ' + ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='INSPECTION_TYPE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') END AS BMS_INSPECTION_TYPE , C.INSPECTION_TYPE AS INSPECTION_RESULT_TYPE FROM TB_BMS_IN I WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN (SELECT IN_NO , INSPECTION_TYPE AS INSPECTION_TYPE , HSN AS HSN FROM TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT WHERE INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = 'N' AND INSPECTION_TYPE IN ( 'P06','X03','X04','X05','X06','S03','S04','S05','S06','SC' ,'I5','I6','I7','I8','I9','I10','I11','I12' ,'J5','J6','J7','J8','J9','J10','J11','J12' ,'K5','K6','K7','K8','K9','K10','K11','K12' ) AND INSPECTION_START_USER_ID <> '' -- AND INSPECTION_START_DATE_TIME >= CAST(CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AS DATETIME) ) AS C ON I.IN_NO = C.IN_NO WHERE
I.CD_TYPE = 'Y'
I.CD_TYPE <> 'Y'
ORDER BY
LIST_ORDER,
I.MBL_NO, C.HSN

/* PdaInspectPaisMapper.checkAllPkgNotInspectE : 검사완료 찍지않은 박스 데이터 갯수 체크 */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo} AND DELETE_YN = 'N' AND INSPECT_STATUS <> 'E'
mapper.update: /* PdaInspectPaisMapper.updateInspectResultFinishWhenExistType : 이미 존재하는 검사결과 완료 처리 업데이트 */ UPDATE TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT SET INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = #{inspectionFinishYn}, INSPECTION_FINISH_REMARKS = #{remarks}, INSPECTION_FINISH_USER_ID = #{updateUserId}, INSPECTION_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo} AND SUBSTRING(ISNULL(INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) IN (#{item})

/* PdaInspectPaisMapper.updateBmsInAndPlanAboutInspection : 반입, 반입예정 검사관련값 업데이트 */ UPDATE TB_BMS_IN_PLAN SET
SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '',
SE_INSPECTION_CODE = #{seInspectionCode},
INSPECTION_TYPE = '',
INSPECTION_TYPE = #{inspectionType},
PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '',
PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = #{paln5emInspectionCode},
UPDATE_USER_ID = #{updateUserId}, UPDATE_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo}
UPDATE TB_BMS_IN SET
XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '',
XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = #{xrayInspectionCode},
SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '',
SE_INSPECTION_CODE = #{seInspectionCode},
INSPECTION_TYPE = '',
INSPECTION_TYPE = #{inspectionType},
PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '',
PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = #{paln5emInspectionCode},
UPDATE_USER_ID = #{updateUserId}, UPDATE_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo}

/* PdaInspectPaisMapper.updateInspectResultStatusInit : 검사결과 상태정보 초기화 */ UPDATE TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT SET INSPECTION_START_USER_ID = '' , INSPECTION_START_DATE_TIME = '' , INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = 'N' , INSPECTION_FINISH_REMARKS = '' , INSPECTION_FINISH_USER_ID = '' , INSPECTION_FINISH_DATE_TIME = '' , REGISTER_USER_ID = #{updateUserId} , REGISTER_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() , SEND_IF_YN = 'N' WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo} AND INSPECTION_TYPE = #{inspectionType}
mapper.select: /* PdaInspectPaisMapper.selectInspectResultCodeValueByInNo : 반입번호로 검사결과 조회 */ SELECT CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'S' THEN ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') END AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'X' THEN ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y' AND UPPER(CODE) NOT IN ('C')), '') END AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'P' THEN ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') END AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 0, 2) = 'I' THEN ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = SUBSTRING(ISNULL(C.INSPECTION_TYPE,''), 2, 4) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='INSPECTION_TYPE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') END AS INSPECTION_TYPE FROM TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT AS C WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo} AND INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = 'N'

/* PdaInspectPaisMapper.selectInspectionTypeByTicInspectResultCode : 이고검사건 검사코드 리스트 */ SELECT v.code FROM ( VALUES ('S01'),('S02'), ('X01'),('X02'), ('P01'),('P02'), ('B'),('A'),('T'),('C') ) AS v(code)
/* PdaInspectPaisMapper.selectBmsIn21ByInPlanNo : 이고반입 조회 */ SELECT * FROM TB_BMS_IN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ORIG_IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo} AND IN_CLASS ='21' AND IN_APPROVAL_NO ='04002001'

/* PdaInspectPaisMapper.updateInspectResultFinishByTicType : 검사결과 업데이트 */ UPDATE TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT SET INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = #{inspectionFinishYn}, INSPECTION_FINISH_REMARKS = #{remarks}, INSPECTION_FINISH_USER_ID = #{updateUserId}, INSPECTION_FINISH_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo} AND INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = 'N' AND INSPECTION_TYPE IN (#{item})
